visualCharacteristics.purpose: responsive image grid; each image opens in an accessible lightbox with previous/next navigation
visualCharacteristics.description: 2 columns on mobile, 3 on tablet, 4 on desktop (1024px and up). The featured variant makes the first image span 2x2. Clicking an image opens a full-screen dialog with large image, optional caption and link, previous/next and close buttons. Section heading and CTA are default content in the section, not part of the block.

contentPattern.structure: One row per image. Cell content: picture (required), caption text (optional plain paragraph), link (optional, shown in the lightbox)
contentPattern.description: Gallery rows with an image each, e.g. Where inspiration meets design on start-your-siding-project (12 images, first one featured); heading and large CTA Browse images sit above and below the block as default content

usage: Use for inspiration or project photo grids that should open larger.
reuseGuidance: For linked image tiles that navigate away use Cards; for a scrolling strip use a carousel.
